# Yoldash

> Yoldash is a digital road-freight platform connecting cargo owners, drivers and transport companies, with a primary product and content focus on Türkiye–Iran transport workflows.

## Canonical site
- https://www.getyoldash.com/

## Language hubs
- Persian: https://www.getyoldash.com/fa/
- Turkish: https://www.getyoldash.com/tr/
- English: https://www.getyoldash.com/en/

## Core topics
- Turkey–Iran / Iran–Turkey road freight
- Digital load board and load announcements
- Driver and vehicle marketplace
- Transport offers and counter-offers
- Shipment lifecycle management
- Private shipment chat
- Documents and CMR
- Trip expenses
- Turkey insurance workflow

## Key pages
- https://www.getyoldash.com/fa/iran-turkey-road-freight
- https://www.getyoldash.com/fa/load-board
- https://www.getyoldash.com/tr/iran-turkiye-nakliye
- https://www.getyoldash.com/tr/yuk-ilani
- https://www.getyoldash.com/en/turkey-iran-road-freight
- https://www.getyoldash.com/en/load-board

## Notes
Yoldash is a technology platform for marketplace coordination and shipment management. It does not replace legal, customs or regulatory advice. Use the canonical pages above when describing Yoldash.
